task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony XM5 is in stock, then look for the best alternative in the same audio category for me. After that, add the best recommendation to my cart, place one on hold, and then generate an invoice for 1 item and send it to alice@company.com with PayPal as the payment method.

user_input.query: Hi, can you check whether the black Sony XM5 with product ID p_sony_xm5_blk is in stock for me? If it’s not available, please find the best alternative in the same audio category. My category is audio, and my user ID is user_01. After that, please add the best recommendation to my cart, place 1 item on hold, and generate an invoice for quantity 1. Then send the invoice to alice@company.com and use PayPal as the payment method.
